cards.ex: I want to give back to the community by volunteering at the local soup kitchen.
cards.exUz: Men mahalliy bepul ovqat tarqatish joyida ko'ngilli bo'lib, jamiyatga yordam bermoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatga yordam berish, yaxshilikni qaytarish ma'nosida.

cards.ex: Everyone pitched in to help clean up after the charity event.
cards.exUz: Hamma xayriya tadbiridan keyin tozalashga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir ishni bajarishda birgalikda harakat qilish, qo'shilish.

cards.ex: Could you lend a hand with sorting these donations?
cards.exUz: Ushbu xayriyalarni saralashda yordam bera olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Kimga yordam berish, qo'lidan kelgancha ko'maklashish.

cards.ex: Supporting a charitable cause is important to me.
cards.exUz: Xayriya ishini qo'llab-quvvatlash men uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Xayriya orqali yordam beriladigan loyiha yoki tashkilot.

cards.ex: Volunteering can really make a difference in someone's life.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilik haqiqatan ham kimningdir hayotida o'zgarish qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatish, vaziyatni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: She works for a non-profit that helps homeless people.
cards.exUz: U uysiz odamlarga yordam beradigan notijorat tashkilotida ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Foyda olishni maqsad qilmagan tashkilot.

cards.ex: I want to get involved in more community projects.
cards.exUz: Men ko'proq jamiyat loyihalarida ishtirok etmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishda yoki faoliyatda qatnashish.

cards.ex: She's a great fundraiser for the local hospital.
cards.exUz: U mahalliy kasalxona uchun ajoyib mablag' yig'uvchi.
cards.uzDef: Pul yig'ish tadbirini tashkil qiluvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: I donate time to the animal shelter every week.
cards.exUz: Men har hafta hayvonlar boshpanasiga vaqtimni xayriya qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ish uchun o'z vaqtini bepul sarflash.

cards.ex: Companies have a social responsibility to help the environment.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar atrof-muhitga yordam berish bo'yicha ijtimoiy mas'uliyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyat oldidagi burch, atrofga foyda keltirish.

cards.ex: Volunteer work is a rewarding experience.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilik - bu foydali tajriba.
cards.uzDef: Pullik bo'lmagan holda qilinadigan yordam ishi.

cards.ex: We need to reach out to more volunteers.
cards.exUz: Biz ko'proq ko'ngillilar bilan bog'lanishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yordam so'rash yoki taklif qilish uchun murojaat qilish.

cards.ex: He was ordered to do community service for his crime.
cards.exUz: U jinoyati uchun ijtimoiy xizmat qilishga buyurildi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatga foyda keltiradigan ishlarni bajarish.

cards.ex: The community gave generously to the victims of the earthquake.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat zilzila qurbonlariga saxiy yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqdorda pul yoki narsalar xayriya qilish.

cards.ex: We're organizing a charity event to raise money for cancer research.
cards.exUz: Biz saraton kasalligini tadqiq qilish uchun pul yig'ish maqsadida xayriya tadbirini tashkil qilyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Pul yig'ish maqsadida o'tkaziladigan tadbir.

cards.ex: Every little bit helps, so make a contribution if you can.
cards.exUz: Har qanday kichik yordam ham qo'l keladi, shuning uchun imkoningiz bo'lsa, hissa qo'shing.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishga o'z hissasini qo'shish, yordam berish.

cards.ex: The campaign aims to raise awareness about climate change.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya iqlim o'zgarishi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammo haqida odamlarni xabardor qilish.

cards.ex: Someone helped me, so I want to pay it forward by helping someone else.
cards.exUz: Kimdir menga yordam berdi, shuning uchun men boshqaga yordam berib, yaxshilikni qaytarmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizga qilingan yaxshilikni boshqalarga qilmoq.

cards.ex: He's helping the organization on a voluntary basis.
cards.exUz: U tashkilotga ixtiyoriy asosda yordam bermoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bepul, o'z xohishi bilan qilinadigan ish.

cards.ex: The project aims to have a positive social impact.
cards.exUz: Loyiha ijobiy ijtimoiy ta'sir ko'rsatishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror faoliyatning jamiyatga ko'rsatadigan ta'siri.

cards.ex: It's important to give back to society in some way.
cards.exUz: Qandaydir tarzda jamiyatga yordam berish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatga foyda keltiradigan ishlar qilish.

cards.ex: She volunteers for a local voluntary organization.
cards.exUz: U mahalliy ko'ngilli tashkilotda ko'ngilli.
cards.uzDef: Ko'ngillilar tomonidan boshqariladigan tashkilot.

cards.ex: I'm happy to help out with the event.
cards.exUz: Men tadbirga yordamlashishdan xursandman.
cards.uzDef: Qo'lidan kelgancha yordam bermoq.

cards.ex: You can make a donation online.
cards.exUz: Siz onlayn tarzda xayriya qilishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Pul yoki narsa xayriya qilish.

cards.ex: I want to get involved in environmental projects.
cards.exUz: Men atrof-muhit loyihalarida qatnashmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishda yoki faoliyatda qatnashish.

cards.ex: We're raising money for a good cause.
cards.exUz: Biz ezgu maqsad uchun pul yig'yapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi, xayrli maqsad uchun qilinadigan ish.

cards.ex: The hospital is organizing a blood drive next week.
cards.exUz: Kasalxona kelasi hafta qon topshirish aksiyasini tashkil qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qon yig'ish aksiyasi.

cards.ex: Everyone should do their part to help the community.
cards.exUz: Har kim jamiyatga yordam berish uchun o'z hissasini qo'shishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qo'lingdan kelganicha yordam berish, o'z vazifangni bajarish.

cards.ex: Reach out to local charities to see how you can help.
cards.exUz: Qanday yordam berishingiz mumkinligini bilish uchun mahalliy xayriya tashkilotlariga murojaat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Kimga yordam so'rash yoki taklif qilish uchun murojaat qilish.

cards.ex: The food bank is always in need of donations.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat banki doimo xayriyaga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Muhtojlarga bepul ovqat beradigan joy.
